question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Consistent**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Consistent **means acting or doing in the same way over time, especially to be fair or accurate. (समय के साथ एक ही तरह से कार्य करना या करना, विशेषकर निष्पक्ष या सटीक होने के लिए)
 
• It refers to a behaviour or pattern that remains steady and predictable.
 
 
• **Example: **The manager praised Sarah for her consistent efforts in maintaining a high level of customer service.
 
 
 
• The use of "**consistent**" in this context implies that ongoing and steadfast efforts are needed to address and control changes in the global climate.
 
• It emphasizes the importance of sustained and reliable action rather than sporadic or temporary measures.

Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Random: **Without a specific pattern or order; occurring without a definite plan or purpose. (किसी विशिष्ट पैटर्न या क्रम के बिना; बिना किसी निश्चित योजना या उद्देश्य के घटित होना)
 
• **Rare: **Uncommon or infrequently occurring; not happening often. (असामान्य या कभी-कभार होने वाला; अक्सर नहीं हो रहा है)
 
• **One-time: **Happening or applicable only once; occurring on a single occasion. (केवल एक बार घटित या लागू होने वाला; एक ही अवसर पर घटित होना)
